decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost accessory that complements the core flooring business, and its promotion to its own page in 2024 signals that its value is being realized rather than resolved negatively.
The maintenance oil line costs little to carry and supports the oiled-floor offer, and its value is still unresolved, so keeping the option open outweighs dropping it.
The care product line gained a dedicated page in 2024, which indicates positive resolution, and it fits the firm's care and maintenance ecosystem at low carrying cost.
The moisture-protection underlay is a cheap complementary accessory with stable website presence, and there is no evidence that its value has failed to materialize.
The high-density underlay foam may overlap with other underlays in the range, but its carrying cost is low and its prospects remain uncertain, so retaining the option is justified.
The oak parquet line sits at the core of the firm's established business and remains consistently present, so it continues as part of the main offer.
